scenes.title: Natural ventilation
scenes.question: Why open the roof?
scenes.intro: Follow the air through the central atrium.

states.label: Roof shut
states.caption: Warm air collects high up. The closed roof interrupts the path for stack ventilation.

states.label: Vent open
states.caption: Warm air leaves above. Cooler outdoor air enters below.

states.label: Hot outdoors
states.caption: The temperature difference reverses. Hot outdoor air can enter above as cooler indoor air leaves below.

scenes.title: Sun protection
scenes.question: What does the overhang do?
scenes.intro: Compare the path of high and low sunlight at one window.

states.label: No overhang
states.caption: Without an overhang, this high-angle ray reaches the window.

states.label: High sun
states.caption: An overhang intercepts this high-angle ray before it reaches the window.
states.note: Same illustrative sun angle · overhang added

states.label: Low sun
states.caption: A lower-angle ray passes beneath the same overhang. Orientation and local sun paths determine when this happens.
states.note: Illustrative low sun · not a site-specific solar study

scenes.title: Building layers
scenes.question: How do the floors fit together?
scenes.intro: Separate the building to understand its levels and central opening.

states.label: Together
states.caption: The floor plates sit around a shared central opening.

states.label: Lift roof
states.caption: Lift the roof to see the rooms and the opening beneath it.
states.note: Exploded view · movement is for explanation

states.label: Separate floors
states.caption: Separating the levels makes their relationship visible. Dashed lines keep corresponding corners aligned.
states.note: Exploded view · not a construction sequence

scenes.title: Compare options
scenes.question: Where should we leave space open?
scenes.intro: Compare a continuous floor plate with a central opening.

states.label: Continuous floor
states.caption: This option keeps the centre within the floor plate.

states.label: Central opening
states.caption: This option leaves the centre open. It trades usable floor area for a vertical connection that needs project-specific assessment.
